definitions.gloss: health resort; retreat; rest area; convalescence destination
definitions.explanation: A place where people go to rest, recuperate, or improve their health, typically in a natural setting with clean air, hot springs, or other therapeutic amenities.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{保養地|ほようち}で{過|す}ごす。
examples.english: To spend time at a mountain retreat.

examples.japanese: {軽井沢|かるいざわ}は{昔|むかし}から{保養地|ほようち}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: Karuizawa has been known as a health resort since long ago.

examples.japanese: {温泉|おんせん}のある{保養地|ほようち}で{心身|しんしん}をリフレッシュした。
examples.english: I refreshed my body and mind at a resort with hot springs.

notes:
Composed of {保養|ほよう} (rest, recuperation) + {地|ち} (place). Refers to destinations valued for their restorative qualities — clean mountain air, hot springs, quiet seaside settings, etc. Many Japanese companies and organizations maintain {保養所|ほようじょ} (rest facilities) for employees.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {温泉|おんせん}{保養地|ほようち}: hot spring resort
- {高原|こうげん}の{保養地|ほようち}: highland retreat
- {海辺|うみべ}の{保養地|ほようち}: seaside resort
- {保養地|ほようち}として{発展|はってん}する: to develop as a health resort

RELATED WORDS:
- {保養所|ほようじょ}: rest facility, retreat house — a specific building or facility (often company-owned)
- {避暑地|ひしょち}: summer retreat — a place to escape summer heat
- {湯治場|とうじば}: hot spring cure site — a place specifically for therapeutic bathing
- リゾート: resort — the loanword, more associated with leisure than health
